principle: Saved assets accelerate discovery but never impose data size, variables, science question or operator ceiling. If relevant evidence is missing, prepare and execute an appropriately scoped new capture. A scope has bounded execution budget; a research program may expand across successively frozen scopes.

triggers: competing mechanisms unidentifiable from saved data
new source strata or independent confirmation required
motion action or downstream video discrepancy
effect heterogeneous or contrary cases require followup
new_scope_gate: identify first native producer and observable
select real independent source clusters and exposure roles
freeze model numeric backend and any GPU device layout
predeclare decision-changing comparison plus stopping rule
register exact bounded scope in ACTIVE
execute through actual native collection, verify RUN/EXIT and payload
reassess evidence and decide if a new scope is needed
